weil_form: q on centered logarithmic test functions

levels.pointwise_translate_values: sign information about k_f(a), insufficient for Gram positivity
levels.cyclic_all_translate: [k_f(a_i-a_j)] is positive semidefinite for every finite translate family
levels.faithful_source_family: cyclic all-translate positivity for a source family whose spans are dense in the Weil test space

implications: faithful source-family positivity gives the full Weil criterion; no lower level implies the next without a proved density or positive-definiteness arrow
bochner_target: for continuous translation-invariant k_f, all-translate positivity is equivalent to a positive Fourier measure
counterexample: k(0)>0 does not prevent a two-translate Gram matrix from having negative determinant
acceptance_test: Construct positive two-variable translate kernels for a source-derived dense test family and prove compatibility with the completed Weil form.
